limitations: This is a bounded inventory from specified public directories and operator pages, not an exhaustive inventory of every recycling service in Metro Vancouver or worldwide.
The full beverage-depot pagination was traversed. The broader Return-It electronics/appliance directory was used to discover public centres; it is not imported wholesale.

Standalone collection bins, Express & GO containers, retailer take-back counters, private industrial processors and the commercial-only Waste-to-Energy Facility are excluded. Specialist scrap yards and private waste businesses are outside this inventory.

Beverage depots are not general garbage destinations. Material program listings are not guarantees that every related item is accepted. Eligibility, cleanliness, volumes, fees and customer rules differ by facility.
No live hours, temporary closures, queue times or fee schedule are supplied. Consult each linked official source before a trip.

Return-It markers and civic-address points are approximate and are not verified entrances or accessibility guidance. Richmond Recycling Depot and Vancouver South Transfer Station use low-accuracy street-block geocodes.
Ridge Meadows Recycling Depot and Maple Ridge Recycling and Waste Centre are distinct adjacent services with the same civic-address point; they are intentionally retained separately.
CITY normally reflects the source's community/postal locality, which can differ from municipal boundaries (including White Rock, Aldergrove, Ladner and Tsawwassen labels).
Operator service notes are manually reviewed as of the recorded date; an automated refresh updates Return-It records and geocodes but does not re-review those notes.
